summary: Under any complex embedding vᴴQ₁v becomes positive definite.

steps.claim: The definition by one equation, for a left inverse l of v.
steps.lean:
| ⟨_, h⟩ => by apply_fun Φ ofNonempty; simpa [RingHom.map_det, map_conjTranspose] using
    ((linkMetric_posDef _).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
    (HasLeftInv.mulVec_injective ⟨_, by simpa using congr(Matrix.map $h (Φ _))⟩)).det_pos.ne'

steps.claim: Apply a complex embedding Φ (at some infinite place): Φ(vᴴQ₁v) = Φ(v)ᴴΦ(Q₁)Φ(v) is positive definite, because Φ(Q₁) is (linkMetric_posDef) and Φ(v) is injective (it has the left inverse Φ(l)); so its determinant is positive, hence det(vᴴQ₁v) ≠ 0.
